race.comment: I AM THE STORM (8) settled close to the pace the went to the front and closed the race off well to win for the second time in as many appearances this prep last start over 1720m at this track, getting there by 2.5 metres. Will enjoy a pretty soft run from this draw, with the sprint lane to play a big role. Won't find this any harder and he can take care of this line-up. APOLLOSTORM (10) is in tremendous form with wins at his last three starts, most recently when he was too good over this track and distance four weeks ago. May just need a bit of luck at some point from this difficult draw. Tackles a similar assignment and he can go right on with the job. MAAS BETTING AGAIN (9) is flying at present with three successive wins to her name, most recently at this track two weeks ago. Big chance to keep the ball rolling. KEAYANG SWEETHEART (5) has been about the mark of late and must be respected, the latest offering a sound third at this track over 2240m.
